about: Age groups (plans/21-age-groups.md, D-38). Difficulty is one shared scale 1–15 (1 = a 6-year-old can answer it, 10 = a 16-year-old, 15 = trivia specialists); each group plays a window of it. `focus`: the group the authoring pipeline writes for; null writes across the whole scale with even targets (D-40). levels: 12 difficulty ranges per group, level 1 first; young_teens = D-22; the others are a draft until tuned (AG-7).
